title: Slab Manager
description: Prevents placing double slabs and lets you lock top/bottom slab placement.
body:
## Slab Manager

**Slab Manager** improves how slabs are placed so building is faster and less frustrating.

## What this mod does

- Adds smarter slab placement logic.
- Reduces misplacements when targeting slab positions.
- Makes slab building feel more consistent during normal gameplay.
- Lets you switch slab placement mode with the **`U` key** (default).

## Why download it

- Saves time while building.
- Gives more reliable slab placement in tight spaces.
- Keeps gameplay lightweight and focused on quality-of-life improvements.

## Controls

- **`U`**: Toggle/switch slab mode.
